reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in your DM: she told me on 14 Oct that Bay 30 is her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups. She hasn't told me about any change since.

Her own message in the DM says this, and the note I saved in gbrain matches it.

The concern I raised last time is still open. gbrain stored that note with `visibility: "world"`, so other members may be able to find it there, even though I told her I wouldn't share it. Someone who can manage gbrain should check that setting.
